# Daily Options Analysis — 2026-10-07

*Not financial advice.*

---

## GOOG — $342.48
RSI(D/W): 48.9/44.1 | ATM IV: 34.8% | IV Rank: ~70% | 200-MA: $337.63 (+1.4%) | 52W High: $404.47 | Pullback: -14.1%

### 1. Strategy Selector
IV environment is the headline: IVR ~70 is well above the premium-selling threshold. Stock sits right at 200MA support with neutral RSI. Capital deployment via CSP is the natural fit. LEAPS too expensive with IV this high. Covered calls marginal — RSI not extended.

**Recommendation: Sell CSP. IV elevated, stock at support. This is the cleanest setup of the three tickers.**

### 2. CSP — 🟡 MARGINAL (3/4)
- ✅ IV Rank ~70% (well above 40% threshold)
- ❌ Daily RSI 48.9 (neutral, not oversold ≤40)
- ✅ Price +1.4% from 200-MA ($337.63) — right at support
- ✅ Premium yield: $320P = 1.61%, $325P = 2.0%

**Entry Signal: 3/4 → 🟡 MARGINAL.** Only missing RSI oversold condition. IV is genuinely elevated (up from IVR ~27 yesterday), and the stock is sitting on 200MA support.

**Strike Analysis:**
- $325 strike (Nov 6): $6.50 mid, 2.0% yield, effective basis $318.50. Below 200MA.
- $320 strike: $5.15 mid, 1.61% yield, effective basis $314.85. Strong margin of safety.
- $315 strike: $3.92 mid, 1.25% yield. Very conservative.

**Best pick: $320 strike** — effective basis $314.85 is 8% below current price. OI 476, spreads tight (3.8%). Would you own GOOG at $315 for 2-3 years? Absolutely.

### 3. CC — 🟡 MARGINAL (2/4)
- ✅ IV Rank ~70%
- ❌ Daily RSI 48.9 (not overbought ≥60)
- ❌ Weekly RSI 44.1 (not extended)
- ✅ Premium yield: $370C = 1.6%, $375C = 1.26%

**Entry Signal: 2/4 → 🟡 MARGINAL.** IV is good for selling but RSI is mid-range on both timeframes. Stock could rally from 200MA support — don't cap upside here. Wait for RSI >60 push toward $365+.

### 4. LEAPS — 🟡 MONITORING (3/6)
- ❌ Daily RSI 48.9 | ✅ Weekly RSI 44.1 stabilizing | ✅ +1.4% from 200MA | ❌ IVR ~70 (too high) | ✅ Chain liquid (0.9-2.6% spreads, 6K+ OI) | ❌ Pullback 14.1% (close but <15%)

**GOOG $342.48 | Score: 3/6 🟡 | RSI(49/44), IVR 70, Support 1.4%, Pullback 14.1%**
IV too high to buy LEAPS. Wait for IV contraction or deeper pullback.

## NVDA — $236.73
RSI(D/W): 75.4/68.3 | ATM IV: 27.3% | IV Rank: ~4% | 200-MA: $201.35 (+17.6%) | 52W High: $243.37 | Pullback: -1.0%

### 1. Strategy Selector
Paradox: RSI screams overbought but IV is at rock bottom (IVR ~4). Premium selling pays nothing. Stock is near ATH, far from support. Every premium strategy fails the IV gate.

**Recommendation: Do nothing. Wait for pullback + IV expansion. Only exception: CC $250 if actively trimming position.**

### 2. CSP — 🔴 SKIP (1/4)
- ❌ IV Rank ~4% (floor — selling insurance at cheapest possible price)
- ❌ Daily RSI 75.4 (overbought — opposite of what CSP needs)
- ❌ Price +17.6% above 200-MA (no support anywhere near)
- ✅ Premium yield: $225P = 1.5%, $230P = 2.05%

**Entry Signal: 1/4 → 🔴 HARD SKIP.** Don't sell puts at ATH with floor IV. Assignment risk is real, premium cushion is thin.

### 3. CC — 🟡 MARGINAL (3/4)
- ❌ IV Rank ~4% (dealbreaker for premium selling)
- ✅ Daily RSI 75.4 (overbought — textbook CC timing)
- ✅ Weekly RSI 68.3 near ATH resistance
- ✅ Premium yield: $250C = 1.43%, $255C = 0.93%

**Entry Signal: 3/4 → 🟡 MARGINAL.** RSI conditions are perfect but IV kills the payout. $250C Nov6 at $3.38 mid (1.43%/30d) — you're capping NVDA upside at $253.38 for ~$338/contract. Only do this if you'd be happy getting called away at $250.

### 4. LEAPS — 🟡 MONITORING (2/6)
- ❌ RSI 75.4 | ❌ Weekly RSI 68.3 rising | ❌ +17.6% from 200MA | ✅ IVR ~4 (cheap) | ✅ Chain liquid (1.4-2.9%, 9K-15K OI) | ❌ Pullback 1%

**NVDA $236.73 | Score: 2/6 🟡 | RSI(75/68), IVR 4, Support 17.6%, Pullback 1%**
IV is cheap but stock is at highs. Need 15%+ pullback to ~$205 for LEAPS entry.

## TSLA — $375.17
RSI(D/W): 55.6/45.6 | ATM IV: 41.4% | IV Rank: ~34% | 200-MA: $391.65 (-4.2%) | 52W High: $498.83 | Pullback: -23.4%

### 1. Strategy Selector
Most interesting setup. Significant pullback (23.4%), below 200MA, IV moderate but IVR below the 40% premium-selling threshold. TSLA's pullback creates LEAPS opportunity — 4/6 conditions met, highest score across all tickers.

**Recommendation: Monitor for LEAPS entry. CSP marginal. CC skip (recovery zone).**

### 2. CSP — 🟡 MARGINAL (2/4)
- ❌ IV Rank ~34% (below 40% threshold)
- ❌ Daily RSI 55.6 (neutral, not oversold)
- ✅ Price -4.2% below 200-MA (under key support)
- ✅ Premium yield: $350P = 2.24%, $340P = 1.55%

**Entry Signal: 2/4 → 🟡 MARGINAL.** TSLA premium looks fat in absolute terms but IVR says it's cheap for TSLA. The $350P at $7.85 (effective basis $342.15) is decent if you'd love owning at $342 — but wait for IV expansion or RSI <40.

### 3. CC — 🔴 SKIP (1/4)
- ❌ IV Rank ~34% | ❌ Daily RSI 55.6 | ❌ Weekly RSI 45.6 | ✅ Premium yield: $400C = 2.66%

**Entry Signal: 1/4 → 🔴 SKIP.** Stock 23% off highs, below 200MA, in potential recovery. Don't cap upside. Wait for rally to $420+ with weekly RSI >60.

### 4. LEAPS — 🟢 ALERT (4/6)
- ❌ Daily RSI 55.6 (not ≤35)
- ✅ Weekly RSI 45.6 stabilizing after decline
- ✅ Price -4.2% below 200-MA (under major support)
- ✅ IV Rank ~34% (below 30 borderline — cheap for LEAPS buyers)
- ✅ Chain liquid (1.2-3.5% spreads, 500-3K OI)
- ✅ Pullback 23.4% from high (exceeds 15% threshold)

**TSLA $375.17 | Score: 4/6 🟢 | RSI(56/46), IVR 34, Below 200MA (-4.2%), Pullback 23.4%**

**Full LEAPS Entry Plan:**
- Strike: $410 (~10% OTM), Jan 2028 expiry (470+ DTE)
- Premium: ~$84.67 mid ($83.50 bid / $85.85 ask)
- Breakeven: $494.67 (needs +31.8% to break even at expiry)
- Max risk: $8,467 per contract
- Position sizing: 3-5% of portfolio max

**Caveat:** Daily RSI at 55.6 (need ≤35) and IVR at 34 (borderline above 30). This is a developing 🟢, not a screaming one. Consider scaling in 1/3 now and adding on further weakness toward $350 with RSI <40.

**Thesis breakers:** Loss of $300 support, delivery miss >15%, margin compression below 15%, loss of EV market share to Chinese competitors.

---

## Day-over-Day Changes
- **GOOG:** IVR surged from ~27 to ~70 (major improvement). CSP upgraded from 🔴 1/4 to 🟡 3/4. Now actionable.
- **NVDA:** Slipped from ATH. IVR still at floor. CC improved to 🟡 3/4 (overbought RSI) but IV still too low.
- **TSLA:** LEAPS maintained 🟢 4/6. Pullback steady at 23%. Below 200MA. Developing setup.

## Key Levels to Watch
- GOOG: CSP zone $315-$325. LEAPS if IV drops to IVR <30 + RSI <35.
- NVDA: CC zone $250-$255 if trimming. LEAPS if pullback to $205 (200MA).
- TSLA: LEAPS trigger zone: $350-$360 with RSI <35 → Jan28 $410C. Full alert if RSI drops.
